name: add_tests_cpp_anagram_checker
description: Write C++ tests (assert.h) for a case-insensitive, punctuation-ignoring anagram checker (already correct - do not modify it); mutation-checked (case-fold dropped on one side, length-mismatch check loosened, non-alphabetic filtering dropped)
prompts: is_anagram(const std::string& a, const std::string& b) in is_anagram.h (already correct - do not modify it) returns true if a and b contain the same multiset of letters, ignoring case and ignoring any non-alphabetic characters (spaces, digits, punctuation). Write a C++ test file at exactly test_is_anagram.cpp that #includes "is_anagram.h" and uses assert() (from <cassert>) to check at least 8 cases in a main() function that prints something and returns 0 on success: a simple true case, a MIXED-CASE true case, a phrase with spaces that is an anagram of another phrase, a false case, a case where digits/punctuation must be ignored, both strings empty, strings of different alphabetic length, and one more of your choice.

test_setup_files.mutation_check.py:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

IMPL = Path("is_anagram.h")
TEST_CMD = ["g++", "-std=c++17", "-Wall", "test_is_anagram.cpp", "-o", "test_is_anagram_bin"]
RUN_CMD = ["./test_is_anagram_bin"]

MUTANTS = [
    # case-folding dropped for the SECOND string only - "Listen"/"SILENT"
    # wrongly reported as not anagrams
    ["sb += (char)std::tolower((unsigned char)c);", "sb += c;"],
    # only ONE side gets sorted before comparing - two strings with the
    # same letters in a different order are no longer recognized as
    # anagrams unless b happened to already be pre-sorted
    ["std::sort(sb.begin(), sb.end());", "// sb intentionally left unsorted (BUG)"],
    # non-alphabetic filtering dropped for the first string - punctuation
    # and digits now count as letters, so "a1b" and "ab" are no longer
    # treated as anagrams
    ["if (std::isalpha((unsigned char)c)) {\n            sa += (char)std::tolower((unsigned char)c);\n        }",
     "sa += (char)std::tolower((unsigned char)c);"],
]


def run_tests() -> int:
    for p in Path(".").rglob("__pycache__"):
        shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
    try:
        compile_rc = subprocess.run(TEST_CMD, timeout=60).returncode
        if compile_rc != 0:
            return compile_rc
        return subprocess.run(RUN_CMD, timeout=30).returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return 124


src = IMPL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
for old, _new in MUTANTS:
    assert src.count(old) == 1, (
        f"protected implementation file {IMPL} was modified - the task said not to "
        f"change it (anchor not found exactly once: {old!r})")

rc = run_tests()
assert rc == 0, f"model tests FAILED against the correct implementation (exit {rc})"

try:
    for i, (old, new) in enumerate(MUTANTS, 1):
        IMPL.write_text(src.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
        rc = run_tests()
        assert rc != 0, (
            f"mutation {i} SURVIVED: the tests still pass against a deliberately "
            f"broken implementation, so they do not verify the required behavior")
finally:
    IMPL.write_text(src, encoding="utf-8")

print(f"PASS (killed all {len(MUTANTS)} mutants)")
